panels.description: This is an internal library dashboard that enables the other dashboards. It should not be deleted.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(datetime) AS d,
  uniq(username) as "Total_Username",
  uniq(origin) as "Total_Origin",
  uniq(apphost) as "Total_EAA_APPS",
  uniq(cloudZone) as "Total_cloudZone",
  SUM(bytesIn) "Incoming",
  SUM(bytesOut) "Outgoing",
  uniq(conUuid) as "Total_Connectors"
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter() 
  AND origin != '-'
  AND username != '-'
  AND apphost != '-'
  and conUuid != '-'
GROUP BY  d
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Users per APP; du=${__user.login}'

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ${eselect}, maxOrNull(datetime) as Last_Access 
FROM ${table} 
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)  
AND ${generalescaping}
AND $__adHocFilter() 

-- ### PPP WARNING COPY (AND KEEP ALIGNED!) THIS BLOCK IN ALL CUSTOMLIBRARIES QUERIES!
AND (
    CASE
        -- Apply one of the following filters if customquery has its value
        WHEN '${customquery}' = 'CQnoapphostdash' THEN apphost != '-'
        WHEN '${customquery}' = 'CQnoapphostconuuiddash' THEN apphost != '-' AND conUuid != '-'
        WHEN '${customquery}' = 'CQnoapphostorigindash' THEN apphost != '-' AND origin != '-'
        WHEN '${customquery}' = 'CQnoapphostoriginusernamedash' THEN apphost != '-' AND origin != '-' AND username != '-'
        WHEN '${customquery}' = 'CQnoapphostusernamedash' THEN apphost != '-' AND username != '-'

        WHEN '${customquery}' = 'CQnoconuuiddash' THEN conUuid != '-' AND conUuid IS NOT NULL
        WHEN '${customquery}' = 'CQnoconuuidorigindash' THEN conUuid != '-' AND conUuid IS NOT NULL AND origin != '-'
        WHEN '${customquery}' = 'CQnoconuuidusernamedash' THEN conUuid != '-' AND conUuid IS NOT NULL AND username != '-'

        WHEN '${customquery}' = 'CQnoorigindash' THEN origin != '-' 
        WHEN '${customquery}' = 'CQnooriginusernamedash' THEN origin != '-' AND username != '-'
        
        WHEN '${customquery}' = 'CQnousernamedash' THEN username != '-'

        WHEN '${customquery}' = 'CQlastuserlogin' THEN username != '-' AND ( urlPath = '/saml/sp/response' AND idpinfo = 'UNSPEC|D' AND username != '-')
        WHEN '${customquery}' = 'CQuserfailedlogin' THEN username != '-' AND idpinfo IN ('LOGIN|F', 'MFA|MF')
        WHEN '${customquery}' = 'CQclientversion' THEN clientVersion IS NOT NULL AND clientVersion != '-' AND username != '-'

        -- don't filter by default
        ELSE 1=1
    END
)

-- PPP don't copy this block into the panel: full list external timerange (inactive things)
AND (
    CASE
        -- if CTlast30 get only last 30minutes of results
        WHEN '${customtime}' = 'CTlast30' THEN datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE

        ELSE 1=1

    END
)
-- ### 

group by ${eselect}

order by Last_Access desc
limit ${querieslimit}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Last accessing users; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: ${etitle} details

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  username,
  min(datetime) AS window_start,
  max(datetime) AS window_end,
  count(DISTINCT geoCountry) AS distinct_countries,
  groupArray(DISTINCT geoCountry) AS countries_seen
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
GROUP BY
  username,
  intDiv(toUnixTimestamp(datetime), 100000) -- to be sure we are totally inside window start window end
HAVING distinct_countries > 1
